title: NECA: Neighbor Event Curve Augmentation for Multi-Horizon ICU Deterioration Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.40420v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Early prediction of ICU organ dysfunction events supports timely clinical monitoring and intervention, but estimating short-term organ-specific risk from early ICU records remains challenging due to irregular measurements, heterogeneous clinical variables, and the need to predict risk across multiple future horizons. Existing supervised models usually treat each patient as an isolated sample and do not explicitly use the observed event timing of similar historical patients. We propose Neighbor Event-Curve Augmentation (NECA), a model-agnostic method that retrieves training-set patients with similar early-window profiles and converts their subsequent organ dysfunction event onset times into cumulative event-curve features over 6h, 12h, 24h, and 42h. translated_title: NECA：面向多时间窗口ICU恶化预测的邻居事件曲线增强方法
translated_abstract: ICU器官功能障碍事件的早期预测有助于及时的临床监测和干预，但由于测量不规律、临床变量异质性以及需要预测多个未来时间窗口的风险，从早期ICU记录中估计短期器官特异性风险仍然具有挑战性。现有的监督模型通常将每个患者视为孤立样本，并未显式利用相似历史患者的已观测事件发生时间。我们提出了邻居事件曲线增强（NECA），这是一种与模型无关的方法，它检索训练集中具有相似早期窗口特征的患者，并将其随后的器官功能障碍事件发生时间转换为6小时、12小时、24小时和42小时的累积事件曲线特征。这些特征与原始患者表示拼接后，供标准下游预测器使用。在PhysioNet 2012和一个包含4000条住院记录的MIMIC-IV子集上，NECA提升了平均……
tldr: NECA通过检索训练集中早期特征相似的邻居患者，并将其后续器官功能障碍事件发生时间转换为多个时间窗口的累积事件曲线特征，从而提升ICU恶化风险预测性能。
en_tdlr: NECA retrieves similar historical patients and converts their event onset times into cumulative event-curve features across multiple horizons, improving multi-horizon ICU deterioration prediction.
